# SMD Services — Current-State Strategy Brief (anchor as of 2026-06-30)

SMD Services is a solutions-consulting venture under SMDurgan, LLC, **pre-launch** (nothing sold yet). It has pivoted repeatedly; this brief describes where it is **now**, not its stale states. The two most recent moves that override older framing are **ADR 0039** (Operator-led assessment funnel, 2026-06-05) and the **2026-06-29 superseding block in `docs/marketing/positioning-spine.md`** (firm-with-flagship structure). When older docs conflict with these, the newer ones win.

## 1. What SMD sells today — two offerings, one firm

SMD sells two things into one firm-level identity (`docs/handbook/business-model.md`; ADR 0004 locks 1–2):

1. **Scope-based consulting engagements** — the original core. The prospect arrives without a fixed solution; SMD surfaces objectives in an assessment conversation, designs a solution, and quotes a **fixed project price**. Delivery spans six categories: process design, custom internal tools, systems integration, operational visibility, vendor/platform selection, AI & automation (CLAUDE.md; Decision #16/#18). Five phases — assessment, solution design, implementation, training, handoff — every engagement runs all five; **scope sets depth, not presence**.

2. **The Operator SKU** — a productized, **flat-rate monthly retainer** and SMD's recurring-revenue product (ADR 0004, renamed from "Operator" to **"Operator"** by ADR 0034 on 2026-06-01). It is the recurring product that **superseded** the old undefined "$200–500/mo retainer" (Decision #12).

The canonical frame for the Operator is **ADR 0037 (the Operator Thesis)** — load it first. Six tenets: (1) it **competes with a hire, not software** — incumbent systems (Clio, the AMS, the PSA) are _connection targets, not competitors_, and price is set against a **salary**; (2) it is a **configurable substrate**, not a tool with one use case; (3) **no imposed defaults** — unconfigured is fail-closed, a safety state not an identity; (4) the **moat is the harness + the guide + the memory**, never a single feature; (5) **packs turn the universal into the recognizable**; (6) targeting is **market-driven on reachability × willingness-to-pay**.

## 2. ICP / the buyer

The buyer is the **owner** of an established, owner-led business with real operational load and ability to pay (`business-model.md`). **No revenue-band gate** — the old "$750k–$5M" filter was retired (ADR 0003; Decision #2 superseded). Qualification happens **in conversation**, not by filtering on a guessed revenue figure. The "too big for one person, too small for a COO" line still captures the _shape_ of the buyer but is not a filter. Launch verticals for consulting: home services + professional services, with contractor/trades third (Decision #3). For the Operator specifically, targets are defined by the vertical packs.

## 3. The "two front doors" → collapsed to one assessment entry (ADR 0039 + 2026-06-29 spine)

This is the most important current-state correction. The "two front doors" language (ADR 0004) still describes the firm's two _offerings_, but the **front door of the website is now singular**:

- **ADR 0039** establishes a **voice-capable assessment-interview Operator** as the front-of-funnel. Flow: ad click → web-widget Operator runs the assessment (discloses it is AI, qualifies in conversation) → drafts evidence-bound findings (seeds `customer.yaml`) → findings render to a **premium report in the client portal** → the report entices a follow-up call → **the human (Scott) joins to deliver the read and close**. The load-bearing seam: **operator captures and drafts; the human owns the verdict and the close** ("automate the data layer, amplify the human layer, never the reverse"). The report is the X-ray; the human-delivered read is the radiologist — the verdict/prioritization/fix is **deliberately withheld** from the report as the conversion engine.
- **The 2026-06-29 positioning spine** reframes the _site_ as **firm-with-flagship**: SMD is a software-and-AI solutions firm for small businesses; **the Operator is the flagship within it, not the whole company**; **the assessment is the one front door**, leading to a recommendation, a project, or an Operator. "We specialize in AI and will tell you when it isn't the answer." The site collapses from ~13 pages to **5 types**: Home, `/operator` (flagship deep page), `/industries` + 12 packs, `/book` (the assessment front door), `/about`. Killed/301'd: `/why` → `/operator#compare`, `/consulting` → `/`, `/ai` → `/`, `/contact` → `/book`.

So: **one assessment entry point on the site; consulting is an _outcome_ of the assessment, not a competing door** (Captain decision #3). The Operator is the flagship outcome.

## 4. Geography and the 12 vertical packs

- **Consulting is Arizona-local.** Phoenix metro, **in-person default for Phase 1** (first 5 clients), remote-capable after proof of model (CLAUDE.md; Decision Stack quick reference). Distribution is local-networking-driven — BNI, Phoenix chambers, PHCC/ACCA/ASCPA, accountant/bookkeeper referrals (Decisions #21–25).
- **The Operator packs are national.** The funnel is web-widget + ElevenLabs voice (BYO-LLM on Anthropic), **inbound/warm-first, no telephony, no TCPA surface, no cold outbound voice** (ADR 0039 §3) — geographically unbounded.
- **Twelve vertical packs** exist under `operator/verticals/` with matching `/packs/*` marketing pages (confirmed on disk): **accounting, dental, home-services, insurance, law-firm, marketing-agency, med-spa, mortgage, property-management, ria, title, veterinary**. The bar each must clear is `docs/marketing/pack-standard.md` (Captain decision 2026-06-29): target the **core operational lifecycle, not the front desk** (the paralegal-deep work, not "answer the phone"); name systems as **generic categories, never brands**; **orchestrate, don't replace**; **walk the lifecycle step-by-step** (Operator does X · your part · if it stalls); **every empirical claim sourced or cut**; honest trust mechanics; one collaborative assessment close. Packs must be built **one at a time behind a Captain gate, never twelve-at-once** (the original twelve were a cookie-cutter — every page led with the same front-desk pitch and an unsourced labor-market claim, a credibility leak being corrected).

## 5. Positioning / voice laws and pricing posture

**Positioning (positioning-spine.md, locked):** SMD names a _category_, not a role — **the gap between capable people and capable software**, filled by a **"Managed Operator"** (a new kind of worker). Narrative nests: **symptom → gap → worker → managed**. Voice laws (CI-enforced in `tests/forbidden-strings.test.ts`, `tests/landing-page.test.ts`): never disparage people or software; "managed" is load-bearing ("a guide in this wilderness"); transience is one quiet factor; "we/our team" voice (first-person "I" only in `About.astro`); **no em dashes, no published dollar amounts**. Firm-level voice stays solutions-consulting — "Operator is the knife; SMD is the chef" (ADR 0004). Anti-fabrication is **P0**: never invent client-facing content (timelines, scope, prices, names).

**Pricing posture:** No dollar amounts published anywhere external (Decision #16). Internal rate ladder $175→$200→$250→$300/hr; client sees a project price, not the rate. **The assessment is a filter, not a revenue play** — fee is a _throttle on the scarce end_ (Scott's close calendar), with **credit-back** making any number a pre-payment. Volume-first now (first 3 free, then $250), raising the gate (toward ~$999) as the close calendar fills (ADR 0039 §6). The binding constraint is **close-calls per week × conversions per call**, not raw lead volume.

## 6. LOCKED vs HYPOTHESIS

**LOCKED:**

- The decision to **build the voice-capable assessment-interview Operator** (ADR 0039, accepted).
- Operator = configurable substrate competing with a hire; moat = harness + guide + memory (ADR 0037).
- Firm-with-flagship site structure; single assessment front door; 5 page types (positioning-spine 2026-06-29).
- Two-layer taxonomy: **6-cat delivery** (marketing) vs **5-cat observation** (`process_design`, `tool_systems`, `data_visibility`, `customer_pipeline`, `team_operations` — lead-gen), bridged by the assessment, never silently merged (ADR 0001).
- Pricing-as-filter, no published dollars, anti-fabrication P0, voice laws.
- Operator architecture: per-customer Fly Machine, Hermes substrate, configurable autonomy ceilings (Decisions #46–49; ADRs 0006–0009, 0025/0035).

**Explicit HYPOTHESIS (ADR 0039 names these, with reversal triggers):**

- The **funnel model around** the interview operator — report-in-portal enticement, human-owned close, conversion economics — is a hypothesis until real prospects run through it.
- That the **withheld-read report entices booked close calls** (the conversion mechanic).
- That the **give-away risk** (prospect takes the report elsewhere) is correctly priced.
- That interview **caliber can be made reliably top-tier** on evals + real calls (if not, "the _model_ is wrong, not the execution").
- **Operator monthly price** is still deferred (ADR 0004 — pending stack cost analysis); service-contract terms unbuilt.
- The **gap visual motif** is greenlit but unbuilt (must be proven small first; positioning-spine §6).

# SMD Lead-Generation: Current-State Brief

_Prepared 2026-06-30 for the research panel. Authoritative on what exists, what runs, what was retired, and what the live data says. Do not re-propose anything marked retired or already-built._

## 1. The built outbound engine

SMD already operates a four-pipeline outbound signal engine, an enrichment layer, an admin CRM, and a decoupled outreach drafter. This is not a greenfield problem — the machinery exists and runs daily.

**Four signal pipelines** (each a Cloudflare Worker with a cron trigger, posting to `POST /api/ingest/signals.ts`, which dedups by `UNIQUE(org_id, slug)` so one business = one entity with many signal rows):

- **Job postings — `workers/job-monitor`** (Pipeline 2). Pulls Arizona job postings via **SerpAPI** (`serpapi.ts`), strips staffing-agency/syndicator noise, runs Claude qualification (`qualify.ts`), and writes direct-employer operating-business signals. Carries `actor_role` and a derived pain score. This is the highest-volume real-pain source (104 entities).
- **New-business — `workers/new-business`** (Pipeline 3). Pulls city permit/license records via **SODA** (`soda.ts`) plus ACC/ROC corporate-filing data. Post-ADR-0003, permits are _enrichment, not triggers_: only Scottsdale licenses (true `actor_role: 'business'`) create entities; contractor/unknown records route through three-tier address recovery (`recovery.ts`, `address-index.ts`) or are dropped. Still the largest source by count (238) because of pre-pivot history.
- **Review-mining — `workers/review-mining`** (Pipeline 1). Discovers businesses via Google Places, fetches and scores recent reviews for operational pain via **Outscraper** (`outscraper.ts`, ~$0.003/place). Only 2 entities — barely exercised.
- **Social-listening — `workers/social-listening`** (Pipeline 4). Monitors Reddit for owner pain, dedups, emails a digest. **No Claude qualification; pure discovery.** Critically, **it has never been wired** — it needs `REDDIT_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/USERNAME/PASSWORD`, and there are no Reddit creds in prod. Effectively dead.

**Enrichment — 13 modules** (`src/lib/enrichment/modules.ts`), dispatched via `dispatchEnrichmentWorkflow` after entity creation, run by the `enrichment-workflow` Worker in three tiers: Tier 1 — Google Places, Website Analysis, Outscraper, ACC Filing, ROC License; Tier 2 — Review Analysis, Competitors, News Search; Tier 3 — Deep Website, Review Synthesis, LinkedIn, Intelligence Brief, **Outreach Draft**. This produced the 2,154 enrichment context rows.

**Admin CRM.** Entities flow through stages (`signal → prospect → meetings → engaged → proposing`, plus `lost`) in `/admin/entities`, backed by D1 with typed context rows (enrichment, signal, outreach_draft, stage_change, intake, extraction).

**Outreach drafting** (`src/lib/claude/outreach.ts`). Per ADR 0003 decision #4, drafting is _decoupled_ from qualification — it runs only after Captain promotes an entity, and passes through a two-stage Pattern-A validator (banlist fast-path + Haiku structural classifier) so no draft claims pre-knowledge of the prospect's business. Sends are recorded in `outreach-events.ts`.

## 2. Two taxonomies, deliberately distinct

There are **two** taxonomies and they are not a bug ([ADR 0001](docs/adr/0001-taxonomy-two-layer-model.md)):

- **Observation taxonomy (5 areas)** — `process_design`, `tool_systems`, `data_visibility`, `customer_pipeline`, `team_operations` (`src/portal/assessments/extraction-schema.ts`). This is what the scrapers/scorers detect from public data. (A legacy v1 six-item list — owner_bottleneck, lead_leakage, etc. — survives only for backward compat.)
- **Delivery taxonomy (6 categories)** — process design, custom internal tools, systems integration, operational visibility, vendor/platform selection, AI & automation. This is the marketing/doctrinal source of truth for what we sell.

Outreach speaks observation; marketing speaks delivery; the assessment call is where the human translates between them. Editing one side must not silently rewrite the other. A panel proposing to "unify the taxonomy" would be reversing a locked Captain decision.

## 3. The live data reality (prod D1, 2026-06-30)

357 entities, earliest 2026-04-01, most recent created **today** at 13:05 UTC — matching the 13:00 UTC job-monitor cron, confirming **the scrapers still run every morning**. Source mix is ~96% outbound: new_business 238, job_monitor 104, review_mining 2, website intake/scan/booking/scorecard ~12, system 1.

By stage: lost 198, signal 143, meetings 7, prospect 6, engaged 2, proposing 1. **The 198 "lost" is not failed outreach** — ~194 are the ADR-0003 reconciliation, wrong-actor contractors bulk-marked lost when actor-identity filtering went in. The handful at meetings/engaged/proposing trace to **inbound website entries, not outbound**.

Two facts dominate everything a panel should reason about:

- **A ready inventory is sitting untouched.** Of 143 signal-stage entities, **139 are enriched and 102 already have a drafted outreach message** — fully built, never sent. The expensive part (discovery + 13-module enrichment + drafting) is already paid for on ~100 leads.
- **No real outbound conversion experiment has ever run.** `outreach_events` has 139 rows, **all `event_type='sent'`, with zero opens, clicks, bounces, or replies**. A genuine cold campaign to 139 live inboxes cannot produce zero opens _and_ zero bounces — so these are synthetic/test sends, or the Resend webhook was never wired. Either way: SMD has **no conversion data**. The engine has never been pointed at the market and measured.

## 4. What was retired, and what was NOT

- **Outside View — the public-footprint DIAGNOSTIC** ([ADR 0002](docs/adr/0002-outside-view-unified-diagnostic.md), superseded). Retired 2026-05-04 in PR #702 (user surface: portal tab, `/portal/outside-view`, public form) and #703 (infra: prospect plumbing, `src/lib/diagnostic/` ~2,764 LOC, `ss-scan-workflow` Worker, the empty `outside_views`/`scan_requests` tables). Reason: public-footprint scraping **surfaced nothing useful** as a client-facing diagnostic artifact. **Precision matters: the retired thing was the diagnostic deliverable, NOT outbound prospecting.** The scrapers and enrichment that feed the CRM are alive and running today. Lead-magnet routes (`/scan`, `/scorecard`, `/outside-view`) now 301 to home.
- **The $750k–$5M revenue gate** ([ADR 0003](docs/adr/0003-lead-gen-pivot-actor-identity.md), 2026-05-07). Removed because no data source exposes revenue — it gated on a heuristic guess of an unverifiable field, and a pre-revenue venture has no business filtering volume before measuring conversion. Geography also widened Phoenix-only → statewide Arizona. **Structural disqualifiers remain** (national chain, government/school, non-profit, shell LLC, enterprise/500+). Size is retained as telemetry only.

## 5. The honest gaps

1. **No measurement wiring.** Zero opens/clicks/bounces/replies means deliverability/engagement tracking (Resend webhook → `outreach_events`) is unproven or absent. ADR 0003 explicitly flagged end-to-end conversion telemetry (signal → assessment booked → engagement signed) as the missing metric — "the current architecture is flying blind on outcomes."
2. **No deliverability setup.** No evidence of sending-domain warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC validation, or a real-inbox send path. Sending to 139 cold inboxes without this risks the domain.
3. **Drafts of unknown quality.** ~100 drafted messages exist but none has been read against a real reply. They pass the Pattern-A validator (no fabricated business knowledge), but no human has graded them and no prospect has responded.
4. **No current written lead-gen strategy doc.** The origin doc `docs/strategy/lead-gen-strategy-2026-04-25.md` was deleted (the entire `docs/strategy/` directory is gone); the surviving authority is ADRs 0001/0003 plus `CLAUDE.md`. There is no single living strategy artifact a panel can anchor to.

**Bottom line for the panel:** the build problem is largely solved; the unsolved problem is _validation_ — wire measurement + deliverability, send the ~100 ready drafts to real inboxes, and get the first real conversion signal. Do not re-propose Outside View, a revenue gate, Phoenix-only targeting, or taxonomy unification.
